one_line: Name the real moment (the summer holiday) as the reason to buy, and let unscripted use be the proof.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 static eye-level shot: a man in a white sleeveless shirt lifts a toddler onto stacked cardboard boxes and laughs at the camera; she holds a plush and a pacifier. Sound: a sung sound, then "הלואו!" (transcript). No text.
q1_hook.why: A smiling parent and a toddler give a face, a voice and a real moment in the first second (H4, K8), and the casual tone reads as a creator, not an ad (H8). But there is no text, the first words are a greeting, and the product is named only near 0:09 (H1, H6, H2).

beats.what: Dad and toddler on stacked boxes; he says they are opening the package "שקיבלנו מבליס" (transcript)
beats.why: Context and a spoken disclosure, but no product yet

beats.what: Camera in the hall; the toddler walks to the lens and squints a smile
beats.why: Cute, but adds no product information

beats.what: Toddler hugs a plush at a long box marked BLISS; dad opens it, "ג'ימבורי הביתה" (transcript)
beats.why: Names the idea, a play gym at home

beats.what: Dad pulls plastic off a cream cube; the toddler comes close
beats.why: First look at a piece, the unwrapping

beats.what: Pink wedge ramp up; the toddler climbs it holding a tape roll
Dad leans on the cube and talks to the camera about the summer holiday (transcript)
beats.why: The parent's reason to buy, over a static frame

beats.what: Cube with a round pouf, the toddler crawls through the tunnel; dad adds a box on top
beats.why: Child and product together, the best action

beats.what: Brown steps built; the toddler climbs up and down with dad's help
beats.why: More climbing, the same kind of picture

beats.what: Dad sits her on the steps and talks to the camera; "ותראו את זה בסטורי" (transcript, 1:26)
beats.why: Soft pointer to Stories, then it stops

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. Only a spoken "ותראו את זה בסטורי" (transcript, about 1:26) points to Stories; nothing asks for a comment, save, share or tag.
q2_flow.why: The story is simple and the toddler's climbing keeps giving new pictures (K2, R3), but at 103 s the product is properly shown only from 0:32, and long talking stretches over a static frame sag (R1, R2).

q3_cta.what: None on screen or in the caption. Spoken only, near the end: "אבל את זה אני כבר אעשה לכם סטורי / ותראו את זה בסטורי" (transcript, 1:24-1:28). Caption: only the @bliss.il tag.
q3_cta.why: The only pointer is spoken, not shown, and sends viewers to Stories, not to an offer or link (C6). The sell stays very light, one brand line (C7), at the cost of any visible next step.

q4_shown.what: BLISS-printed boxes from 0:00; a cream cube under plastic 0:32; a pink ramp with the toddler climbing 0:37; the cube with a round pouf, the toddler crawling through 0:57-1:11; brown steps, the toddler climbing 1:12-1:29. No price, size or age.
q4_shown.why: A toddler climbing, crawling and sitting on each piece is real use a parent can picture (K8, S6), though the first piece is in use only from 0:37 (S1). Saying the set was received from the brand is an early spoken disclosure (S7). No price is given (S3).

q5_edit.what: 10 shots in 103 s, about 10 s each; 9 hard cuts, all before 1:10. Two long static takes of 29 s (0:36-1:05) and 33 s (1:10-1:43). No speed changes, no text. Dad's voice and room sound throughout. Ends on dad and toddler.
q5_edit.why: Long single takes feel authentic but keep pauses (box handling, dad adjusting) that jump cuts would remove (E2, R1). All meaning rides on sound and nothing is on screen, so it fails muted (E4). It ends mid-play, with no payoff or ask (E8).

q6_topic.what: A foam play set (ramp, tunnel cube, steps) unboxed and tried by a dad and his toddler as a summer-holiday idea for parents who run out of things to do.
q6_topic.why: Parents running out of ideas in the long holiday is a real, seasonal concern said in plain words (K6, K7). The toddler's own antics are the humour, a moment parents recognise (K3).

q7_filmed.what: A propped phone, static at eye level, in an entry hall with a dark-blue wall and white door, daylight; handheld 0:12-0:17. A man and a toddler about 2 on camera; a face is cut by the frame edge at 0:00 and 0:20.
q7_filmed.why: A home hall and daylight look native (H8, F7). Dad speaks to the lens at times (F6). Faces cut at the edges break the safe zone (F2), while the cube fills the frame in the close stretch (F4).

q8_text.on_screen: None in any sampled frame (one every 1.5 s): no subtitles, headline, labels or CTA text. The only words are BLISS printed on the cardboard boxes.
q8_text.caption: "כשאת מכינה את הבית לחופשת הקיץ עם ילדים 🧚🏽‍♀️". Two lines and 3 hashtags (#סוזיבום #אבאגאה #גימבורי); the second line names "ג׳ימבורי מושלם של חברת @bliss.il". No CTA, question or disclosure word.
q8_text.why: With sound off, nothing explains the Reel, since the dad's words are not on screen (T1, T3). The caption's first line names the occasion and the hashtags are specific (T7). The partnership is only a tag, with no disclosure word in the caption (T8).

weak_points: 103 s with the product shown from 0:32 and in use from 0:37; no text for a muted viewer; no visible CTA; two long static takes; faces cut by the frame edge; disclosure only spoken and tagged.
lumebook_takeaway: Prop the phone, say one real-moment line to camera while opening the parcel, add burned-in subtitles, and cut it to 30 to 60 s.
not_verified: Quick on-screen text between the 1.5 s samples. The machine transcript is garbled and covers only the first 90 s, so only short phrases are quoted and the last 12 s of speech are unknown. Whether music plays. Whether the man is the account owner. Whether the post was paid. Correction to src/coded: the boxes carry the brand print from 0:00, but the product pieces first appear at 0:32 and are in use from 0:37, not 0.0 s.
